currentOperations.refreshPolicy: Manually verified saved source snapshot. Retraining does not reverify or refresh this operational status.

limitations: Targets are weather-derived challenge proxies. No historical airport direction or RWY18 closure log was available; scores do not measure actual operations accuracy.
METAR gust absence is replaced with reported sustained wind; this may miss gust-related restrictions. VRB/missing wind directions are excluded.

Direction proxy uses observation timestamps and a >30-minute adverse-wind persistence rule; gaps reset persistence. Ground wind alone omits upper winds, ATC, noise rules, traffic, aircraft-specific limits and runway works.

Archived forecast lead times are 24h (1h/6h model), 48h (24h model) and 72h (48h model), conservatively predating origins. Live inference uses freshest ICON, so live feature distribution differs; reported scores are archive tests.
Probabilities are logistic scores with held-out Brier evaluation, not independently calibrated operational probabilities. No positive closure event support means no closure-recall claim.
Between tested horizons, dashboard chooses nearest model. 48-hour UI is hourly; no 30-minute transition timing precision is claimed.
